engine.workdirConfirmBody: The script runs in its own directory: relative paths find its data, and files it writes by relative path land in the project directory exactly as in a terminal, overwriting same-name files. Tavotto still doesn’t save its figures, and blocks deleting, renaming, or moving project files. Applies to this project only.
engine.workdirHintProject: The script runs in its own directory: relative paths find its data; files it writes by relative path land in the project directory, overwriting same-name files. Deletes and renames are still blocked.
engine.workdirHintProjectRoot: The script runs in the project root: relative paths find data from there; files it writes by relative path land in the project directory, overwriting same-name files. Deletes and renames are still blocked.
engine.workdirHintSandbox: Turn on to run in your local environment for better compatibility.
engine.workdirNowProject: Scripts now run in their own directory. Rerunning.
engine.workdirNowProjectRoot: Scripts now run in the project root. Rerunning.
engine.workdirNowSandbox: Scripts run in the sandbox again.
engine.workdirOptionFoundNone: None of the files the script reads are found here
engine.workdirOptionHint_project: cwd is the script's own directory: relative paths resolve next to the script.
engine.workdirOptionHint_project_root: cwd is the project root: relative paths like data/x.csv resolve from there.
engine.workdirOptionHint_sandbox: cwd is Tavotto's sandbox: read-only relative paths fall back to the script's directory; written files never touch the project.
engine.workdirRootConfirmBody: The script runs in the project root: relative paths resolve from there, and files it writes by relative path land in the project directory exactly as in a terminal, overwriting same-name files. Tavotto still doesn’t save its figures, and blocks deleting, renaming, or moving project files. Applies to this project only.
engine.workdirSuggest: Does the script find its data by relative path (os.path.exists, glob, ovito…)? It runs in Tavotto's sandbox, where those paths don't reach your project files.

preflight.axisLabelFormat: The axis title “{{label}}” isn't in the profile's “{{want}}” form.
preflight.barWithoutErrorbar: The bar chart has no error bars. If the bars are means of repeated measurements, the profile expects the error shown.
preflight.bitmapEmbed: Flipped or semi-transparent figures are embedded in the PDF as bitmaps at export DPI. Vector text isn't preserved.
preflight.cjkFallbackMissing: Text with CJK characters uses {{family}} with no CJK fallback declared. It exports as boxes in the PDF.
preflight.cjkFallbackUnaccepted: Text with CJK characters is drawn by {{face}} (body font {{family}}), not among the CJK fonts the profile accepts.
preflight.discouragedColormap: The colormap {{cmap}} isn't perceptually uniform; the profile recommends {{recommended}}.
preflight.elementOutsideFigure: An element extends {{mm}} mm past the figure edge. The part outside is cut off on export.
preflight.exportRasterDpi: Exporting {{formats}} at {{dpi}} dpi is below the profile's {{min}} dpi
preflight.fitWithoutCi: A fitted curve has no confidence band. Submissions usually require the uncertainty of the fit.
preflight.fontBelowFloor: Figure text has an effective size of {{effective}} pt, not above the absolute floor of {{floor}} pt.
preflight.fontFamilySubstituted: Figure text uses {{family}}; the profile requires {{want}}.

preflight.fontTooLarge: Figure text at an effective {{effective}} pt exceeds {{max}} pt, larger than body text.
preflight.fontTooSmall: Figure text at an effective {{effective}} pt is below the profile's {{min}} pt
preflight.frameWidthOffPreset: The frame's effective line width {{effective}} pt isn't one of the profile's steps ({{presets}} pt).
preflight.glyphMissing: The current font can't draw {{count}} character(s) in this figure text — they export as boxes: {{chars}}
preflight.glyphSubstituted: {{count}} character(s) in this figure text are drawn with a different font (automatic fallback): {{chars}}
preflight.hidden: Hidden objects won't appear in the export.
preflight.legendFontSize: The legend's effective font size {{effective}} pt is outside the profile's {{min}}–{{max}} pt.
preflight.legendFrame: The legend has a frame; the profile requires a frameless legend

preflight.lineWidthOffPreset: The effective line width {{effective}} pt isn't one of the profile's steps ({{presets}} pt).
preflight.missingAsset: A figure references an asset that isn't in the current figure library. Export will fail or come out blank.
preflight.outOfPage: An object extends past the page. The part outside won't appear in the output.
preflight.outsideMargin: An object crosses the {{margin}} mm safe-area margin
preflight.overlap: Figures overlap each other. Confirm this is intentional before exporting.
preflight.pageAspect: The page aspect {{ratio}} ({{w}} × {{h}} mm) isn't one of the allowed ratios ({{allowed}}).
preflight.pageWidth: The page width {{actual}} mm isn't one of the profile's column widths ({{want}} mm).

preflight.spinesNotEnclosed: The axes are missing {{sides}}. The profile requires them enclosed.

preflight.textBelowFloor: Canvas text at {{size}} pt is not above the absolute floor of {{floor}} pt

preflight.textGlyphSubstituted: {{count}} character(s) in this canvas text fall back to a different font: {{chars}}
preflight.textOverAxes: {{a}} runs {{w}} × {{h}} mm into the plotting area of {{b}}
preflight.textOverlap: Text overlaps other text by {{w}} × {{h}} mm ({{a}} and {{b}})
preflight.textTooSmall: Canvas text at {{size}} pt is below the profile's {{min}} pt
preflight.textWeightPolicy: The profile expects {{role}} to be {{want}}; currently {{got}}.
preflight.tickDirection: Tick direction is {{got}}; the profile requires {{want}}
